agentPlugins.name: iManage
agentPlugins.description: Interact with your iManage Work platform using natural language. This MCP server connects to your iManage account to search workspaces, folders, and documents, inspect document profiles and version histories, read document contents, and manage legal and knowledge work workflows directly from your AI tools.

agentPlugins.name: Salesforce
agentPlugins.description: Search and manage Salesforce records from your Salesforce remote MCP server. Connect to your Salesforce instance to search across objects (SOSL), execute SOQL queries, inspect object schemas, traverse related records, and create, update, or delete records.

agentPlugins.name: Courtroom5
agentPlugins.description: Civil legal guidance for people navigating court without a lawyer. This MCP server provides educational guidance for self-represented litigants in U.S. civil legal matters across all 50 states, including case intake assessments, procedural deadline calculations, and prioritized next-step guidance directly from your AI tools.

agentPlugins.name: Opsera AI Agents
agentPlugins.description: Intelligent DevSecOps automation for your development workflow, powered by natural language. Connects your AI coding agent (Antigravity) to 150+ integrated DevOps tools via MCP — security scanning, pipeline generation, compliance auditing, and documentation, all via plain-English commands without leaving the IDE. Source code analysis runs locally; only structured results are returned to the portal.

agentPlugins.name: Forge
agentPlugins.description: Forge is an AI-powered platform that automates the earliest, most time-consuming phase of software development — the "Day 0" planning that typically takes weeks of meetings, documents, and back-and-forth. Exposes project/repo linking, PRD/BRD/architecture artifact retrieval, work-order management, commit/PR automation, and CI/CD pipeline tools directly to your AI coding agent.

variables.name: <FORGE_API_TOKEN>
variables.title: Forge API Token
variables.description: Your Forge API token used to authenticate with the MCP server.

agentPlugins.name: Endor Labs
agentPlugins.description: Bring Endor Labs security into your AI tools. With this MCP server, you can check dependency safety before adding a new package, scan your open source dependencies for vulnerabilities and malware, find leaked secrets accidentally committed in your Git history, run static analysis (SAST) on your code, and perform AI security reviews on your code changes.

variables.name: <ENDOR_NAMESPACE>
variables.title: Endor Labs Namespace
variables.description: (Optional) Your Endor Labs tenant namespace. Required for Enterprise Edition only; the free Developer Edition runs with no configuration.

variables.name: <ENDOR_MCP_SERVER_AUTH_MODE>
variables.title: Authentication Mode
variables.description: (Optional) Enterprise Edition authentication method: "github", "gitlab", "google", or "sso". A browser window opens automatically on first use to complete authentication.

variables.name: <ENDOR_MCP_SERVER_AUTH_TENANT>
variables.title: SSO Tenant
variables.description: (Optional) SSO tenant name. Only needed when the authentication mode is "sso".

agentPlugins.name: Canva
agentPlugins.description: The Canva MCP server enables AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Canva's design capabilities. By exposing Canva's capabilities (including design creation and editing, asset and brand management, library search, export, and commenting) as MCP-compatible tools, you can give your users access to Canva's design capabilities through natural language, directly from the AI tools they already use.

agentPlugins.name: Chrome DevTools for agents
agentPlugins.description: Enable Antigravity to control and inspect a live Chrome browser, with access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.
